Hickerson’s half-sister Ashley Hickerson told the Daily Mail she “gets” why the actress ultimately went back to her brother, despite suffering years of abuse at his hands. Panettiere wrote extensively about several incidents during her relationship with the realtor in her memoir This Is Me: A Reckoning , released in May. “The slaps become hits,” she wrote, until he “busts up my face so badly I don’t leave the house for weeks.” Read more at The Daily Beast.
